instructions:
## Task objective

Curate a 5,000-row subset of coding-agent rollout trajectories (SWE-bench/SWE-smith-trajectories, ticks split, ~25.8k rows; mapped to {messages, instance_id, resolved, model, traj_id}) so an SFT Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct solves as many SWE-bench Verified tasks as possible when driven by mini-SWE-agent. Budget is 5K trajectories. Baseline: random. EVAL SCOPE: the metric is SWE-bench-Verified resolve-rate via an agentic pipeline (vLLM serve the finetuned model -> mini-SWE-agent rollout over the instances -> SWE-bench Apptainer grading harness). Eval runs on the host-side stage run_swe_eval_srun.sh (NOT run_bench_stage_srun.sh — the harness + rollout issue apptainer themselves). Two tiers: - Tier A (validated): the verified-mini subset (Verified instances whose per-instance eval SIFs are already built) runs end-to-end on the cluster today. - Tier B (deferred): the full 500 Verified instances. --dataset_name points at the full swebench_verified.json, but a full run needs all 500 instance images built (rollout singularity + eval SIFs) on a large allocation. The trajectories are encoded with the model's native ChatML template (assistant-only masking); the rollout prompts in the same format. Absolute resolve-rates track this harness + mini-SWE-agent scaffold + subset, not a leaderboard number.

## Controlled curation loop

Inspect the supplied pool and implement a selection policy in the editable curation workspace. Produce the requested subset with the required schema, run the audit, and submit it through the benchmark CLI. The harness trains the fixed base model using the prescribed recipe and evaluates the checkpoint. Use the returned feedback to revise the selection policy. Do not alter the protected training or evaluation implementation.

## Exact published task configuration

```yaml
task:
  task_id: swe_traj_qwen7b_verified
  domain: swe
  goal: >
    Curate a 5,000-row subset of coding-agent rollout trajectories
    (SWE-bench/SWE-smith-trajectories, `ticks` split, ~25.8k rows; mapped to
    {messages, instance_id, resolved, model, traj_id}) so an SFT
    Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct solves as many SWE-bench Verified tasks as possible
    when driven by mini-SWE-agent. Budget is 5K trajectories. Baseline: `random`.

    EVAL SCOPE: the metric is SWE-bench-Verified resolve-rate via an agentic
    pipeline (vLLM serve the finetuned model -> mini-SWE-agent rollout over the
    instances -> SWE-bench Apptainer grading harness). Eval runs on the host-side
    stage `run_swe_eval_srun.sh` (NOT run_bench_stage_srun.sh — the harness +
    rollout issue apptainer themselves). Two tiers:
      - Tier A (validated): the `verified-mini` subset (Verified instances whose
        per-instance eval SIFs are already built) runs end-to-end on the cluster today.
      - Tier B (deferred): the full 500 Verified instances. `--dataset_name` points
        at the full swebench_verified.json, but a full run needs all 500 instance
        images built (rollout singularity + eval SIFs) on a large allocation.
    The trajectories are encoded with the model's native ChatML template
    (assistant-only masking); the rollout prompts in the same format. Absolute
    resolve-rates track this harness + mini-SWE-agent scaffold + subset, not a
    leaderboard number.
  target_rows: 5000
  training_stage: finetuning
  model_key: qwen2.5-coder-7b-instruct
  model_name_or_path: __MODEL_PATH__
  target_evals:
    - SWEBenchVerified
  strategy_timeout_seconds: null
  default_submission_dir: curated/final_submission
  training_config:
    # SWE-trajectory-adapted recipe (train_swe_traj_sft.py owns it): LoRA r=64,
    # lr 1e-5, cosine, max_seq_len 16384, bf16, 1 epoch. num_processes drives a
    # single-GPU run.
    num_processes: 1
    timeout_seconds: 36000
  eval_config:
    benchmarks:
      - SWEBenchVerified
    offline: true
    mode: all
    timeout_seconds: 72000
    gpu_id: 0
    # Default runs the full verified-mini subset (Tier A). To run more/all of
    # Verified (Tier B), raise n_instances or set instances_file/instance_ids
    # here once the per-instance images are built.
    eval_options:
      instances_file: verified_mini_instances.txt
  dataset:
    dataset_id: swesmith_trajectories
    local_path: __DATASET_PATH__
    split: null
```

Configuration source: [curation-bench/src/benchmark/tasks/swe_traj_qwen7b_verified.yaml](https://github.com/Jiachen-T-Wang/curation-bench-pro/blob/fb418bc9ce1c52416550ba6abf5968d8d594c760/curation-bench/src/benchmark/tasks/swe_traj_qwen7b_verified.yaml), [Apache-2.0 license](https://github.com/Jiachen-T-Wang/curation-bench-pro/blob/fb418bc9ce1c52416550ba6abf5968d8d594c760/LICENSE).
